_meta.catalogue_source: JLC parts API (POST selectSmtComponentList, exact LCSC code), fetched 2026-11-08; price = JLC unit price at the lowest tier; library_type: "basic" (no setup fee), "preferred" (extended with the preferred flag, no setup fee in economic assembly), "extended" (~$3 setup per line)
_meta.datasheets: downloaded to the session scratchpad (not in the repo); sha256 = shasum -a 256 of the PDF fetched from datasheet_url; text via pdftotext -layout; curve values marked "read from figure" were read off rendered plots (about +-10-20 %)
_meta.fit_method: ngspice-45 DC operating point with the current forced, Nelder-Mead on relative V error; TVS fits use the phase-1 structure (IS 1e-12, N 1, IBV 1 mA fixed; BV, RS fitted) so they drop into protection_screen.network(); err_pct = (model - datasheet) / datasheet

dut_lo_pair.notes: Recommended over a Schottky for the virtual ground: zero-bias conductance is what the TIA sees. Estimated pair shunt (N*Vt/Isat, Isat ~ typ low-V IR): ~1.5-3 Mohm at 25 C, ~60 kohm at 85 C, vs BAT42 ~190 kohm at 25 C and ~3 kohm at 75 C. Clamps higher (model 1.13 V @ 0.1 A, 2.9 V @ 1 A extrapolated from the max-VF fit; typical is lower) - far inside U7A 7 V differential; the phase-2 screen rerun must confirm. 0.97 A for ~1.7 us vs IFSM 4 A @ 1 us / 1 A @ 1 ms. Stretch 13 A: no. Basic part: no line fee. (1N4148WS C2128, already on Rev F, is a two-part fallback.)

dut_lo_pair.notes: The Schottky option as specified in phase 1 (0.4 V class, IFSM 4 A covers the 1 A surge). Risk: its zero-bias conductance rises ~8x per 25 C; estimated pair shunt ~3 kohm at 75 C at the TIA virtual ground (100 k range noise gain ~30, and a temperature-dependent current-sharing error). Fit: N fixed 1.05 (a free N runs to 5 on these max points); errors +5 %, -11 %, +4 %.

isolation_switch.spice_model: on: R 1 (2 max); off: C 20p || R 60G (IOFF max -> R >= 60 Mohm at 60 V)
isolation_switch.notes: Four singles, one per jack. Drive: two strings of two LEDs from VBUS (2 x 1.4 V max) with ~400 ohm and one AO3400A (already on Rev F) -> ~10-11 mA total (~55 mW) at 5 mA per LED. Opens within 0.5 ms of losing VBUS. Off-state sees only the jack clamp (~8-10 V at the target). On-state surge current ~0.97 A (LCUR) vs IONP 1.5 A (100 ms): covered; stretch 13 A: no. Coff 20 pF replaces the phase-1 1 pF; rerun the unpowered rows.
